name: Volunteer Work
overview: Scripture calls believers to actively show compassion and generosity toward those in need, instructing them not to harden their hearts or withhold help from their poor brothers. The principle of treating others as one would wish to be treated underscores this call, emphasizing that giving results in blessings both for the giver and the recipient. Drawing out one's soul to the hungry and satisfying the afflicted brings spiritual light and favor, while generosity is promised abundant return according to the measure one gives.
